## Commits / title

Use [Conventional Commits](docs/commit-convention.md) for PR title and commit subjects:

`<type>(optional-scope): <description>`

Examples: `feat: …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`, `chore: …`

CI job `commitlint` checks every commit on the PR range.
